name: Zei Leimin
about: Zei Leimin is an eighteen-year-old Minpentai game champion from Pafogai Du in Dzego, and one of the book's three leads. The book gives his age and a healed arm injury but no looks, so this appearance is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: the recipient 'is successful' and is 18 years old
facts.fact: 18 years old (a message aimed at him).
Plays Minpentai, a high-school programming game.

facts.quote: trying to figure out if his arm was injured enough to be worth complaining
facts.fact: Injured his arm in a bombing in chapter 2.

facts.quote: That arm had been broken and taken a month to heal
facts.fact: His left arm was broken and healed after a month.

facts.quote: offering glasses attached to a long cable
facts.fact: Wears cabled display glasses only at game consoles.

facts.quote: You're a math guy, not a diplomat.
jackets covered in a mixture of white and grey
facts.fact: Wears a white-and-grey jacket in the snow.

facts.quote: Zei whispered into his neck band
facts.fact: Uses a neck band and watch.

descriptor: a young man of eighteen, slim and of medium height, light golden-tan skin, spiky jet-black hair with one bright electric-blue streak, quick dark eyes, wearing an orange zip-up tech jacket with reflective trim over a black t-shirt, grey cargo pants with many pockets, chunky white sneakers and a slim neck band
